value: 2026-11-25 (13) — Two PRs open, from a pass over the issues found earlier that day. #235 (a refused write records INVALID_INPUT on every surface; v1.4.0 milestone; head 24b0567): reviewed, findings fixed, 1,891 tests, READY — waiting for the owner to say merge. #234 (confirm gate; draft; no milestone; head 162c4ea; 1,960 tests): three independent reviews, two approaches dropped, NOT ready. The third review found `rvr rename -G <namespace>` drops a global-list flag that still gates the same key in another project, which main does not. STOPPED there, as the owner was told beforehand: do not iterate on #234 until two decisions are made — (1) should a rename ever remove a flag (recommended: never, it only adds), (2) should `confirm set` refuse a key that is not a stored entry or accept it with a warning. The PR body lists these and the smaller fixes that follow; the reasoning is in context.confirmGate. Found on main along the way, unfiled, security track (project.inFlight): exec output re-scan, MCP confirm_token replay through a re-pointed alias, a write under a Unicode-fold spelling overwriting another entry's file. STILL OPEN FROM BEFORE: owner decisions O1–O7 in docs/design-189-forum-threads.md; a cycle-completing value stored silently; `get --json` returning raw for a guard or a cycle; default lint not seeing a global entry in a namespace the project also has; the security-audit workflow, owed before 1.4.0 (#230 changed interpolation, #234 touches the run gate).
